neighbours.label: punctuation that joins a reference or parameter to its number: the colon in chapter:verse citations and '=' before a numeric keyword value
fire: God found fault with the people of Israel (Heb. 8:8) and promised a new covenant.
As Paul writes in Romans 12:2, do not be conformed to this world.
The passage is quoted again in John 3:16 and in several letters.
Compare the parallel account in Matthew 5:3 for the same saying.
quiet: God found fault with the people of Israel, as the letter explains, and promised a new covenant.
As Paul writes in his letter to the Romans, do not be conformed to this world.
The passage is quoted again in the gospel of John and in several letters.
Compare the parallel account in the gospel of Matthew for the same saying.
